title: National Parks Tracker Printable, All 63 US National Parks Checklist, Hiking Log, Park Stamp Pages, Canada Parks, Road Trip Gift PDF
description:
Tick off every US national park, one trail at a time. A 26-page printable tracker of all 63 US national parks with one beginner-friendly day hike for each, a visit log and stamp boxes, plus Canada's national parks and reserves.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- How to use and print the tracker
- All 63 US national parks A to Z on one page, with state and a checkbox
- Park pages, 8 parks per page: state, best season, one beginner-friendly day hike with distance in miles and km and elevation gain in ft and m, entry notes (timed entry or reservation where needed), visit date and a stamp box
- The two territory parks: National Park of American Samoa and Virgin Islands
- Canada's national parks and reserves A to Z by province, with a first hike for the 10 most visited
- Park passes in plain words: America the Beautiful and the Parks Canada Discovery Pass
- My park goals, visit log pages, a park stats page, trail etiquette and Leave No Trace, and stamp, ticket and sketch pages

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against nps.gov in October 2026. Park rules and access change, so always check the park's page on nps.gov or parks.canada.ca before your trip. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
